provenance.review_type: Owner-supplied static audit; historical claims, not runtime acceptance or independent manufacturer verification

capabilities.title: Scalable track architecture
capabilities.baseline_limitation: Mixer persists exactly eight tracks; arrangement rows do not remove this limit.
capabilities.acceptance: Create, route, save and reopen 128 independent audio/instrument tracks without fixed-index truncation.
capabilities.benchmark_examples: RE, LP, AL, FL, CU, PT, BW, SA

capabilities.title: Multiple independent instruments
capabilities.baseline_limitation: Project has one SynthPatch and a singleton hosted instrument path.
capabilities.acceptance: Run distinct instruments and presets on independent tracks with separate MIDI, automation and recall.
capabilities.benchmark_examples: LP, AL, FL, CU, PT, BW, RS

capabilities.title: Project sample-rate selection
capabilities.baseline_limitation: Runtime accepts a rate but normal project/UI workflow centers on 48 kHz.

capabilities.benchmark_examples: RE, CU, NU, PT, BW, SA

capabilities.title: Hardware input/output patchbay
capabilities.baseline_limitation: Device selection exists; current audio graph is stereo and capture mono.
capabilities.acceptance: Name and route arbitrary hardware mono/stereo inputs and output pairs per track and bus.

capabilities.title: Multichannel track processing
capabilities.baseline_limitation: Core audio blocks and plug-in chains use stereo paths.
capabilities.acceptance: Preserve channel layouts throughout files, tracks, inserts, buses, meters and rendering.

capabilities.title: Parallel audio-graph scheduling
capabilities.baseline_limitation: Vectorized/native DSP exists; independent graph branches lack a general parallel scheduler.
capabilities.acceptance: Schedule independent branches across cores while preserving dependencies and live-input deadlines.

capabilities.title: Managed disk streaming
capabilities.baseline_limitation: Decoded audio uses bounded heap and memory mapping; explicit read-ahead streaming is absent.
capabilities.acceptance: Stream long multitrack sessions with read-ahead, bounded cache, underrun reporting and seek recovery.

capabilities.title: Selectable audio buffers
capabilities.baseline_limitation: Buffer presets and device setup are implemented.

capabilities.title: Real-time load diagnostics

capabilities.title: Large-session qualification
capabilities.baseline_limitation: Source improvements exist; reviewed material does not establish production-scale hardware results.
capabilities.acceptance: Publish repeatable 128-track low-buffer playback/recording results and agreed dropout limits on supported systems.

capabilities.title: Precision and summing modes
capabilities.baseline_limitation: Main buffers are float32; no user-facing 64-bit mixing mode.
capabilities.acceptance: Provide a validated double-precision summing path with defined conversion boundaries.

capabilities.title: Audio-device recovery
capabilities.baseline_limitation: Device-management code exists; unplug/replug qualification is incomplete.
capabilities.acceptance: Recover from interface loss, rate changes and unavailable devices without project corruption.
capabilities.benchmark_examples: Engineering/product recommendation; no competitor cell verified for this row.

capabilities.title: Simultaneous multitrack recording
